opportunities.name: U.S. DMB Modernization + Payments Participation
opportunities.stage: RFP active; revised proposal and completed pricing due 2026-09-04

single_sales_objective.value: Win the U.S. DMB modernization program; secure a qualified path to payments and adjacent restaurant technology only where customer value and access justify it.

customer_stated_objective.value: Consolidate vendors to improve efficiency, economics and service while maintaining strong fraud and chargeback protection across payment channels. Modernize and unify interior and drive-thru digital menu boards; centralize content, pricing, promotions, scheduling and dayparting; integrate Oracle and NCR for near-real-time price/inventory and outdoor order confirmation; reduce IT/Marketing manual burden; improve brand consistency; and support growth, new stores and future dynamic upsell.

commercial_hypothesis.value: $25/screen/month standalone; $12.50 with qualifying payments participation; white glove $25-$50/screen/month pending scope.

required_deliverables: Revised proposal reflecting updated TDR requirements
All applicable costs, assumptions, optional services, exclusions and supporting details

rfi_commitment_baseline.status: submitted baseline; requires internal validation before conversion to priced commitments
material_claims: Native pricing and order-confirmation integrations claimed for Genius POS, PAR Brink and NCR
Oracle positioned as an API-enabled third-party integration subject to agreements and potential fees
Near-real-time pricing and item availability supported subject to integration and display processing
Dynamic upselling supported natively in Genius; third-party transaction-aware behavior depends on POS APIs
Existing display reuse supported subject to model, age, condition and useful-life assessment
Controller, controllerless and dual-display media-player options offered
Installation, testing and go-live support described as included in the proposal
Three-year warranty stated for quoted hardware

critical: Oracle and NCR integration must be validated by exact product/version and interface
On-screen order confirmation requires lane mapping, data definition and acceptance criteria
Transaction-aware dynamic upselling requires third-party POS validation or a qualified pilot position
Vendor-facility storage, chain of custody, inventory reporting and redeployment operating model
high: Warehouse Stream inventory inspection and compatibility assessment
De-installation at closing or refreshed locations
Managed content workflow, included volumes, turnaround SLAs and fees
DMB-specific support, field service, replacement protocol and approved SLAs
Warranty treatment for new versus reused equipment
Billing frequency, deposits, milestones, invoice timing and pricing validity

criteria.next_step: Confirm budget source and approval path.

criteria.criterion: We have the access we need
criteria.current_read: Direct access to Randy, Diego, Terry and Jorge, a user-confirmed key stakeholder in both payments and the DMB RFI; no verified EBI or coach access.
criteria.next_step: Use Jorge's cross-workstream position to map decision makers, criteria and authority without assuming he is the EBI or Coach.

criteria.current_read: Formal RFP received. Revised proposal and completed SOW/pricing are due 2026-09-04; evaluation scorecard, approvers and veto roles remain unverified.
criteria.next_step: Submit consolidated clarifications and confirm evaluation criteria, decision calendar, approvers and vetoes.
Validate Luis Javier Rodas / Jose Gregorio Baquero role.
Test Scott O'Neill and procurement contacts for coach behavior.

reason.value: Strong technical fit, but no verified customer coach, EBI, budget or decision process.

timing.value: Active modernization; infrastructure described as end-of-life.

competition.value: DMB incumbents include ZoneIn and Stream. Oracle Simphony is the principal broader-platform threat; NCR/Aloha remains in part of the estate. Fiserv is field-reported for in-store processing; Olo/Olo Pay (Stripe) for digital; Valutec for gift. Actual bidder set and preferences remain unknown.

position.critical_test: Is the decision genuinely open and who controls it?
position.immediate_move: Map customer buying influences before claiming pursuit confidence.

strengths.value: Customer-defined, end-of-life DMB need across a growing estate.
strengths.possible_action: Use exact customer language and a requirement/evidence compliance matrix.
strengths.best_action_plan: Receive/qualify full RFP; verify scoring, dates and decision roles.

strengths.value: Genius fits DMB, hardware, integration, rollout and support scope.
strengths.possible_action: Map every requirement to proven capability, partner, dependency or gap.
strengths.best_action_plan: Re-engage Scott O'Neill and map the customer buying system.

strengths.value: Direct customer engagement; Randy committed to share statements, and Jorge independently contacted Tracy after the meeting.
strengths.possible_action: Convert momentum and Jorge's executive relationship path into verified access, decision insight and scheduled work sessions.
strengths.best_action_plan: Validate what Jorge communicated to Tracy, then map Olo/Olo Pay, Stripe, Fiserv, Valutec and POS migration state.

strengths.value: Payments and broader stack create optional enterprise value.
strengths.possible_action: Keep payments optional and prove economics/operational benefit.
strengths.best_action_plan: Approve standalone, participation and white-glove guardrails.

red_flags.value: No verified EBI, customer coach, budget, scorecard or decision calendar.
red_flags.possible_action: Use first clarification/discovery cycle to validate buying influences.

red_flags.value: Oracle migration may already constrain broader platform scope.
red_flags.possible_action: Separate DMB win from speculative POS displacement; verify contract/deployment status.

red_flags.value: Olo/Olo Pay fraud and chargeback value could make digital payments sticky.
red_flags.possible_action: Benchmark authorization, fraud, disputes, token portability and economics before claiming value.

red_flags.value: Screen/store mix and white-glove workload are not validated.
red_flags.possible_action: Price archetypes and explicit assumptions; reconcile to site inventory.

red_flags.value: Bank of America sample statements conflict with field report of Fiserv.
red_flags.possible_action: Treat as entity/store/sample ambiguity until estate architecture is confirmed.
